import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for all sources
    path_source_causa = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"
    path_source_deteccion = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"
    path_source_main = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"
    path_source_actividad = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"
    path_source_factor = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"

    # Load all source tables
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source_causa)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source_deteccion)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source_main)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source_actividad)
    df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_source_factor)

    # The main source (df_main) already contains many columns of the target.
    # However, some columns in the target are IDs and their corresponding descriptive columns are in separate sources.
    # We need to replace the descriptive columns in df_main with the IDs from the lookup tables or vice versa,
    # but the target schema requires both descriptive and ID columns.
    #
    # From the target schema and examples:
    # - 'Causa' (string) and 'IdCausa' (int)
    # - 'Deteccion' (string) and 'IdDeteccion' (int)
    # - 'Actividad' (string) and 'IdActividad' (int)
    # - 'Factor' (string) and 'IdFactor' (int)
    #
    # In df_main, 'Causa', 'Deteccion', 'Actividad', 'Factor' are descriptive strings.
    # We need to map these strings to their IDs using the source lookup tables.
    #
    # Note: df_main does not have IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdActividad, IdFactor columns.
    # We will create these by merging on the descriptive columns.

    # Merge df_main with df_causa to get IdCausa
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left', suffixes=('', '_id'))
    # After merge, df_main has 'IdCausa' from df_causa, keep it and drop duplicate 'Causa_id' if any
    # The merge will add 'IdCausa' column from df_causa, but since df_main already has 'Causa', no conflict.

    # Merge df_main with df_deteccion to get IdDeteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left', suffixes=('', '_id'))
    # This adds 'IdDeteccion' column

    # Merge df_main with df_actividad to get IdActividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left', suffixes=('', '_id'))
    # This adds 'IdActividad' column

    # Merge df_main with df_factor to get IdFactor
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_factor, on='Factor', how='left', suffixes=('', '_id'))
    # This adds 'IdFactor' column

    # After merges, df_main has duplicate columns for the descriptive fields from the lookup tables (e.g. 'Causa_y', 'Deteccion_y', etc.)
    # We want to keep the descriptive columns from df_main (original) and the Id columns from the lookup tables.
    # The merges added columns named 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdActividad', 'IdFactor' (from lookup tables).
    # The descriptive columns from lookup tables have suffix '_id' or '_y' - we do not need those.

    # Drop any duplicate descriptive columns from merges (those with suffixes)
    # The merge with suffixes=('', '_id') adds columns with '_id' suffix for the lookup descriptive columns.
    # We want to drop those.

    cols_to_drop = [col for col in df_main.columns if col.endswith('_id')]
    df_main.drop(columns=cols_to_drop, inplace=True)

    # The target schema columns and their types:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor'
    ]

    # Note: df_main has a column 'Precipitaciones' which is NOT in target schema, so drop it if present
    if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
        df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'], inplace=True)

    # Check if all target columns exist in df_main after merges
    missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_main.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in the merged dataframe: {missing_cols}")

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    df_target = df_main[target_columns].copy()

    # Enforce data types as per target schema:
    # 'Fecha': string
    df_target['Fecha'] = df_target['Fecha'].astype(str)

    # Integer columns:
    int_cols = ['IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'ID', 'V_Viento', 'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor']
    for col in int_cols:
        # Some integer columns might have missing values, convert with errors='coerce' then to Int64 (nullable int)
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')

    # Float columns:
    float_cols = [
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Edad', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min',
        'Presion', 'Dir. vi.', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia'
    ]
    for col in float_cols:
        df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype(float)

    # String columns (the rest)
    str_cols = [
        'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Sexo', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'Estacion', 'Estado'
    ]
    for col in str_cols:
        df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(str).fillna('Sin datos')

    # Save the transformed dataframe to the target path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
